title: Ind-constructible module sheaves form a weak Serre subcategory closed under sums (finite extension E)
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension and $\Lambda=\underline E$ the condensed ring of continuous maps into $E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Let $X$ be a $k$-scheme whose structure morphism $a_X\colon X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type, let $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ be the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ the abelian category of $\Lambda_X$-module objects in abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Call $M\in\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ constructible as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible] (there is a finite stratification of $X$ on whose strata $M$ is pro-étale locally finitely presented), and ind-constructible if it is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of constructible objects. Then the full subcategory of ind-constructible objects of $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions (for a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ with $M',M''$ ind-constructible, $M$ is ind-constructible) and under arbitrary small direct sums.
